objective: Comparar la cobertura mensual real de pagos de ORIGEN (sucursal MPRO 0023) contra la tabla canónica EDARSAHUB para distinguir meses sin operación de meses faltantes y reanudar únicamente los huecos reales. Solo lectura.

queries.name: origen_source_months
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7),v.Vn_Fecha,120) AS periodo,COUNT(*) AS pagos,COUNT(DISTINCT v.Vn_Folio) AS tickets,MIN(CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)) AS fecha_min,MAX(CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)) AS fecha_max,CAST(SUM(cp.Cp_Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento WHERE v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'')<>'CA' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7),v.Vn_Fecha,120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: origen_source_days_2026_jun_sep
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(10),v.Vn_Fecha,120) AS dia,COUNT(*) AS pagos,COUNT(DISTINCT v.Vn_Folio) AS tickets,CAST(SUM(cp.Cp_Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe FROM Venta_Encabezado v WITH (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN Comanda_Pago cp WITH (NOLOCK) ON cp.Co_Folio=v.Vn_Documento WHERE v.Sc_Cve_Sucursal='0023' AND ISNULL(v.Es_Cve_Estado,'')<>'CA' AND cp.Cp_Importe>0 AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)>='2026-06-01' AND CONVERT(date,v.Vn_Fecha)<'2026-09-24' GROUP BY CONVERT(char(10),v.Vn_Fecha,120) ORDER BY dia

queries.name: origen_canonical_months
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7),FechaHora,120) AS periodo,COUNT(*) AS filas,COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket) AS tickets,MIN(CONVERT(date,FechaHora)) AS fecha_min,MAX(CONVERT(date,FechaHora)) AS fecha_max,CAST(SUM(Importe) AS decimal(18,2)) AS importe FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio='ORIGEN' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7),FechaHora,120) ORDER BY periodo
